description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's behavior when merging symbolic links under a filesystem that does not support symlinks. It sets up a test repository, creates branches with different types of files (regular files and symlinks), performs merges, and verifies that the merge results are handled as files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executing the given commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks whether the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail, e.g., a failing merge.
